question: From which bodily sources must the offering material not be taken, O Bhairava?
premises: The offering material has restricted sources.
It must not come from a disease-afflicted limb.
It must not come from another element or improper source.
inference: The material must not be taken from a disease-afflicted limb nor from another element, O Bhairava.
uncertainties: The precise meaning of anyadhātāt in this ritual context is uncertain.
plain_english: O Bhairava, it must not be taken from a disease-afflicted limb, nor indeed from any other improper source.
